summary: The old include generator indexes component zero of an empty package path and panics. The fix uses a module stack and recorded filenames, allowing package-less output to be included at the root. The fix adds tests::write_includes covering this case. Blocked: no valid verbatim reversal was established under the required constraints. Restoring the old implementation changes the method signature and visibility incompatibly with the unchanged regression test and requires the removed Module::to_partial_file_name helper from another file. Restoring only its body leaves incompatible variables and recursive calls. No builds or tests were run.
